oA_Scene.label: oA Scene
oA_Scene.description: The 'oA Scene' represents a scene model. The scene holds defined values for each actuator in one group.

Documentary_Description.label: Documentary Description
Documentary_Description.description: Resource to hold a documentary text description of the object.

Scene_ID.label: Scene ID
Scene_ID.description: The ID that is used to recall the scene. This needs to be unique within one application group.

Application_Group_ID.label: Application Group ID
Application_Group_ID.description: The application group ID the scene definition applies to.

Changeable_by_User_API.label: Changeable by User API
Changeable_by_User_API.description: If true, the settings for this scene can be changed using the User API.

Transition_Time.label: Transition Time
Transition_Time.description: Defines the transition time to be used for changing to this scene.

Scene_Configuration.label: Scene Configuration
Scene_Configuration.description: Defines the list of output properties that are changed when a scene is recalled. Complex Data comprising a Corelnk pointing to the resource, a payload that sets the resource and a boolean that says if POST or PUT should be applied
